notes: REVIEW: Low finding 056274ff67ca reproduced in test/scratch/DustLot.t.sol (harvest and IMD queue tests). Proof: send 1 base unit of harvest token H to Cocoon; startAuction(H) fixes that lot at 100 ETH; add 1000e18 H. startAuction(H) still reverts AuctionRunning after 47 hours, with the dust price above 1e12 wei. At 48 hours the dust can be taken for zero ETH; only then can the real harvest be auctioned. An active dust IMD auction likewise defers later burn funds until taken. This delays funds without losing them. Unresolved: the exact-source, manifest-only mandate prohibits a fix; remediation would require a separately authorized source change and new Cocoon deployment, or explicit acceptance of this residual. Info finding 88f5d7dcc014 reproduced at mainnet block 26176357: Cocoon owner/developer/operator and FloorFeed owner are 0x7a2b112af54419ed0b18e051027f3142c13441d9; Cocoon is unwired and FloorFeed.questionHash is zero. Timelock delay is 172800 seconds. Cocoon and FloorFeed runtimes match this build outside immutables. This is the documented pre-PostLaunch state, not a code defect; no imported finding was disproved. BUILD: Ethereum mainnet, chain 1. Only PupateToken and PupateHook are deployed by this manifest. Token: zero-argument constructor, 1,000,000,000 PUPATE with 18 decimals minted once to its deployer; no owner, mint, pause, fee, transfer limit or blacklist; burn and burnFrom only reduce supply. Hook constructor: ($poolManager, fixed Cocoon sink, fixed 48-hour timelock owner). Permissions encode 0x18CC, validated against its own address; deployment requires a mined CREATE2 salt. The first native-ETH pool initialized on it becomes its permanent launch pool. Tax is on the ETH side of swaps in that pool, with the sink sender exempt: standing sells 6%; buys start at 99% and fall one percentage point per minute to the standing rate after about 93 minutes. Tax is collected inside each swap as PoolManager ERC-6909 claims; swap callbacks call only the PoolManager and move no ETH. A taxed swap specifying ETH must fill completely or revert PartialFill. Permissionless flush redeems claims and delivers the whole hook ETH balance to Cocoon.depositTax. The owner can only lower standing tax and transfer ownership. Liquidity additions require the launch pool and the EIP-1153 mark set in its initialization transaction; all later transactions are refused, including in the same block. Removal and fee collection are ungated. The accepted opening-transaction residual remains: the mark names no account; code gaining control in that transaction could add too. The factory calls only the PoolManager, token and its registry there. Pool: native ETH/PUPATE, fee 12500 (1.25%), spacing 60, sqrtPriceX96 792281625142643375935439503360000, tick 184216, the policy's 10 ETH valuation; 85% pool allocation is policy, not a manifest setting. Cocoon, FloorFeed and PupateVesting are review context. After launch, script/PostLaunch.s.sol wires Cocoon, vests the launch wallet's 5% for 12 months, pins the oracle question and transfers Cocoon and FloorFeed ownership to the timelock. The previous skim reentrancy and _record truncation fixes remain; parked-price burns and slow floor recovery remain accepted residuals (docs/REVIEW.md).
